shellCommands.command: git ls-files | head -100 && cat package.json && ls
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls node_modules | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls __agent_eval__

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "yagr|uplot|chart|d3"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit version 2>&1 | tail -2; npm view yagr version 2>&1 | tail -2
npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | tail -10; npm view uplot version 2>&1|tail -1; git status --short; cat .gitignore

npm install @gravity-ui/yagr@5.3.1 2>&1 | tail -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types|exports|version)"'
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr && sed -n 1,400p README.md | head -200; cat dist/react.d.ts; grep -n '"exports"' -A25 package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && cat YagrCore/index.d.ts | head -150; grep -n -E "theme|adaptive|dispose|setSeries|setConfig|setAxes|setScales|setVisible|timeMultiplier|splitTime" YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -50
cat YagrCore/mixins/dynamic-updates.d.ts; sed -n 100,330p YagrCore/types.d.ts; cat react.mjs | head -150
grep -n "var YagrComponent\|src/react.tsx" react.mjs | head; n=$(grep -n "// src/react.tsx" react.mjs | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1); sed -n "$n,\$p" react.mjs | head -200; ls;
grep -n "setTheme(" -A40 yagr.mjs | head -90; grep -n "dispose() {" -A30 yagr.mjs | head -50
sed -n 1,100p YagrCore/types.d.ts; sed -n 330,520p YagrCore/types.d.ts
grep -n "onResize" -B2 -A30 yagr.mjs | sed -n 1,90p; grep -n "function setSeriesImpl\|function setSeriesDataImpl\|incremental" yagr.mjs | head -20
sed -n 7930,8130p yagr.mjs; grep -n "^function debounce" -A15 yagr.mjs; grep -n "reflow(" -A22 yagr.mjs | tail -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules | grep -i -E "jsdom|happy|playwright|puppeteer|uplot"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome firefox 2>&1 | head; cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && grep -n "class BatchMixin" -A75 yagr.mjs | head -130
grep -n "BatchMixin" yagr.mjs | head; grep -n "recalc" yagr.mjs | head -20
sed -n 8177,8262p yagr.mjs; grep -n "transformSeries(" -A60 yagr.mjs | sed -n 1,110p
grep -n "dblclick\|zoom" yagr.mjs | grep -v "^[0-9]*: *//" | sed -n 1,40p; cat YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/types.d.ts | head -80; grep -n "yagr_theme_\|--yagr-" index.css | head -60

sed -n 80,200p YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/types.d.ts; grep -n "adaptive" yagr.mjs | head; grep -n "show: false\|tooltip" YagrCore/defaults.d.ts | head; grep -n "clientHeight" -B2 -A8 yagr.mjs | sed -n 1,40p

grep -n "get clientHeight" -A12 yagr.mjs; sed -n 8360,8400p yagr.mjs; grep -n "timeMultiplier\|TIME_MULTIPLIER" yagr.mjs | head; grep -n "useThemeValue\|export.*useTheme" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat useTheme.d.ts useThemeValue.d.ts useThemeType.d.ts types.d.ts | head -80; cat useThemeValue.js useThemeType.js
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && grep -n "^var ColorParser\|class ColorParser" -A45 yagr.mjs | head -80; grep -n "colors.parse\|\.parse(" yagr.mjs | head -30
sed -n 180,260p index.css; grep -n "yagr_theme\|theme" yagr.mjs | sed -n 1,40p | grep -i tooltip
grep -n "plugins.tooltip =\|tooltip = \|config.tooltip" yagr.mjs | head; grep -n "tooltip: \|cursor: " -B3 -A6 yagr.mjs | sed -n 1,60p | grep -n "show" ; sed -n 7500,7530p yagr.mjs

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && ls; sed -n 1,120p ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.js 2>/dev/null | head -120; sed -n 8338,8352p /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs
cat ThemeProvider.js | sed -n 1,90p
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && sed -n 6030,6140p yagr.mjs; grep -n "^var DEFAULT_Y_SCALE\|^var DEFAULT_X_SCALE" yagr.mjs
grep -n "get isEmpty" -A6 yagr.mjs; grep -n "isEmptyDataSet" yagr.mjs | head
sed -n 1,60p index.css; grep -n "overrideSeriesInUpdate" -A18 yagr.mjs | head -40

grep -n "function getScale\b\|function getScaleRange\|function getScales\|const getScale" yagr.mjs; n=$(grep -n "^function getScaleRange\|^function getRange" yagr.mjs | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); echo $n; grep -n "scaleConfig.min\|config.min\|\.min !== \|min: " yagr.mjs | sed -n 1,25p
sed -n 6160,6330p yagr.mjs
cat index.d.ts; ls YagrCore/plugins/cursor; sed -n 1,60p YagrCore/plugins/cursor/cursor.d.ts
ls src/CpuLoadChart; grep -c "" src/CpuLoadChart/CpuLoadChart.css; grep -rn "g-color-sfx-shadow\|g-color-base-float\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -3

grep -o "\-\-g-color-sfx-shadow[^;]*;" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -2; grep -o "\-\-g-color-line-generic:[^;]*;" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -2; grep -o "\-\-g-text-body-1-font-weight:[^;]*;\|\-\-g-font-family-sans:[^;]*;" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head

sed -i 's|font: var(--g-text-body-1-font-weight) 12px/16px var(--g-font-family-sans);|font: 400 12px/16px var(--g-font-family-sans);|' src/CpuLoadChart/CpuLoadChart.css && grep -n "font:" src/CpuLoadChart/CpuLoadChart.css
mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1; timeout 240 npm i playwright-core 2>&1 | tail -2; timeout 300 npx playwright-core install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5
id -u; which sudo apt-get 2>&1 | head; (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null) | grep 5199; pgrep -af vite | head

cd /tmp && mkdir -p debs && cd debs && timeout 60 apt-get download libglib2.0-0 2>&1 | tail -3; ls /var/lib/apt/lists | head -3; ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell 2>&1 | grep "not found"

cd /tmp/debs && timeout 200 apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libatspi2.0-0 2>&1 | grep -c Get; mkdir -p /tmp/libs && for f in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x $f /tmp/libs; done; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell 2>&1 | grep "not found"; for l in /tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/*.so*; do ldd $l 2>/dev/null | grep "not found"; done | sort -u

cd /tmp/debs && timeout 200 apt-get download libxrender1 libdrm2 libwayland-server0 libxi6 libsqlite3-0 2>&1 | grep -c Get; for f in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x $f /tmp/libs; done; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell 2>&1 | grep "not found"; for l in /tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/*.so*; do ldd $l 2>/dev/null | grep "not found"; done | sort -u; echo done

npx vite --port 5321 --strictPort > /tmp/vite.log 2>&1 &
sleep 4; tail -4 /tmp/vite.log

sleep 2; tail -5 /tmp/vite.log; sed -i 's/5199/5321/' /tmp/pw/check.mjs; cd /tmp/pw && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu timeout 120 node check.mjs 2>&1 | tail -30
fc-list 2>&1 | head -3; ls /usr/share/fonts 2>&1 | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && sed -n 5975,6036p yagr.mjs; grep -n "X_AXIS_INCRS\s*=" -A25 yagr.mjs | head -40

rm -f harness.html src/__harness.tsx && rm -rf dist && (curl -s -o /dev/null -w "vite:%{http_code}\n" localhost:5321 || true); kill $(ps -eo pid,args | grep "[v]ite --port 5321" | awk '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -6; npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests|passed|failed"; rm -rf dist; git status --short; git diff package.json
for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *"vite --port 5321"*|*"vite.js --port 5321"*) echo "kill ${p#/proc/}: $c"; kill ${p#/proc/};; esac; done; echo ok
